description: Données Ouvertes sur l'État du Réseau Routier au Togo is a data set listed in Togo national open data portal (opendata.gouv.tg), a national open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère des Travaux Publics et des Infrastructures. Ces données fournissent des informations détaillées sur l'état des infrastructures routières au Togo. Elles incluent des données sur la qualité des routes (en bon état, endommagées, nécessitant des réparations) et la répartition géographique des routes nationales, régionales et locales. Coverage: Togo. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère des Travaux Publics et des Infrastructures. Its tags are route. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2024-12-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tg-portal.
